name: 蒂姆·帕特森
bio_short: 美国计算机程序员，MS-DOS的原始作者。他在西雅图计算机产品公司（SCP）工作时，为了适配Intel 8086芯片，编写了QDOS（86-DOS）。微软后来以5万美元买断了这个系统，并将其改名为MS-DOS授权给IBM。他是那个真正写下代码，为微软帝国奠定基石的幕后工程师。
bio_short_en: American computer programmer and the original author of MS-DOS. While working at Seattle Computer Products (SCP), he wrote QDOS (86-DOS) to run on the Intel 8086 chip. Microsoft acquired this system for $50,000, rebranded it as MS-DOS, and licensed it to IBM. He is the engineer who actually wrote the code that laid the foundation for the Microsoft empire.
